scope: Synthetic, local, offline native gRPC stream fixture (HTTP/2, own protobuf codec and message framing, Node built-ins only) plus a driver port on node:http2. Not the approved Node 24 Express control API; no cloud, identity, spend or registration.

order.what: RED subject: an ordinary HTTP/2 substitute (200 JSON, no trailers) and a driver that reports ok when a stream closes
initial behavioral tests written before any implementation (retained snapshots)
RED: 36 of 36 initial tests fail against the stubs, every failure an AssertionError about specified behavior

implementation: protobuf.cjs, grpc.cjs, service.cjs, front.cjs, call.cjs, grpc-server.cjs, report.cjs, driver-call.cjs, driver.cjs; then timers.cjs, transcript.cjs, server.cjs, driver-cli.cjs, index.html, page.js, styles.css

first implementation run of the retained initial tests: 33 of 36 passed. Two tests were mis-specified (superseded, skipped by exact name), one exposed a real gap in the message reader (fixed, original test unchanged)
supplement replayed against the unchanged stubs after the implementation: 4 of 4 fail with AssertionError
retained initial tests plus supplement against the implementation (two superseded tests skipped by exact name)
GREEN: every suite and the retained initial tests (real HTTP/2 sockets, hostile raw servers, manual time)
syntax check of every JavaScript file, no execution
per-file coverage, one L-0004 command per file, 85/85/85 enforced on each row (unloaded counts as 0%)
real isolated headless Edge observation of the transcript page (11 checks); stdout archived without evidence capture
browser record and screenshot captured on purpose with CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 (Edge 156.0.4314.58, Microsoft-signed, qualified major 156)

limits: The browser observed a server-produced transcript, not native gRPC: browsers cannot speak gRPC and the isolated helper allows only same-origin read-only GET.
Node built-ins on the observed test runtime are not the approved Node 24 Express service; no production runtime, identity, durable store, native target or cloud is validated or registered.
Retained RED files and archived runs are immutable; supplement and superseded tests are documented in README.md.
